name: Hamish Te Whero
bio:
Hamish Te Whero's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with engines on his family's farm in rural New Zealand. While his technical skills are still developing, he possesses a remarkable intuition for identifying potential improvements and a relentless drive to push boundaries. Hamish is known for his unorthodox approach to problem-solving and his unwavering belief in the power of innovation.

After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, Hamish started his career in a small racing team, quickly impressing his colleagues with his quick learning and innovative ideas. While he may lack the extensive experience of some seasoned engineers, Hamish compensates with his infectious enthusiasm, fresh perspective, and willingness to embrace new technologies. He aspires to lead a team that consistently challenges conventional wisdom and creates groundbreaking designs.

Hamish views his role as chief engineer not just as a technical position, but as an opportunity to inspire and mentor others. He is committed to fostering a collaborative environment where creativity thrives and every team member feels empowered to contribute their best work. Despite being entry-level, his ambition is to build a team that will make a lasting impact on the sport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A stocky build with a weathered face, Hamish looks like he's spent a lot of time outdoors.

Has a habit of pacing when deep in thought
